summary: On paper Carolina has the edge (Carolina's defense ranks 26th in EPA per dropback, +0.04 allowed), while Tampa Bay's best counter is to run it in short yardage (Tampa Bay ranks 4th in short-yardage run success, 59%). Under center, Bryce Young ranks 7th of 26 in EPA per dropback; x-factor: Emeka Egbuka gets 28% of Tampa Bay's targets and 33% of its air yards, and Carolina's pass defense ranks 26th. The model favors Carolina at 78%, mostly on starting QB (4.0 pts) and passing matchup (3.6 pts).
